check: Authenticate the event, identity, exact cutoff/time zone and permitted communication audience
owner_role: Proposed People owner or authorized sponsor
approval_required: Authorized departure/expiry notice or applicable incident authority
expected_evidence: Verified notice and identity; current cutoff and authority reference
proposed_target: Before planned action or under incident authority
notes: An urgent pre-authorized containment action does not wait for routine paperwork; contractor expiry is not silently extended.

check: Reconcile known identities, applications, tokens, assets, physical access and requester authority
owner_role: Proposed IT coordinator and system owners
expected_evidence: Population from independent inventories; known targets, missing coverage and assigned discovery gaps
proposed_target: Before cutoff where feasible; continue gaps in parallel
notes: Use available scope immediately; incomplete discovery must not delay authorized removal of known access.

check: Obtain records, disclosure, destination, hold and future-disposition direction
approval_required: Applicable records/privacy authority and recipient approval
expected_evidence: Record classes and method; approved recipient/destination; hold and verification requirements
proposed_target: Before dependent transfers, wipe or account/license disposition
notes: Do not invent a retention period; unresolved direction holds destructive steps, not access containment.

check: Map privileged and business dependencies and assign authorized replacements or contingency
owner_role: Proposed Service owners and IT coordinator
approval_required: Receiving-owner authority and approved continuity scope
expected_evidence: Replacement/custody plan; dependency list; tested capability where feasible or owned gap
notes: Conditional privileged workstream; no signature, absent replacement or unfinished handover extends leaver access.

check: Block or suspend each relevant identity at the authorized cutoff
expected_evidence: Saved account state, action time, operator and authoritative-system observation
notes: Use known targets while discovery continues; do not wait for OFF-03 or OFF-04. An OU name is not an account-state control.

check: Revoke applicable sessions and tokens and inspect application-owned session exposure
expected_evidence: Per-service revocation result, remaining exposure and applicable session limitations
notes: Directory blocking alone does not prove all sessions ended; do not wait for transfer or handover.

check: Remove direct application, group, remote-support and vendor requester access
owner_role: Proposed Application owners and scoped providers
expected_evidence: Per-target saved state or provider result, actual time and unresolved access
notes: Expand by service; one failed removal does not delay authorized removal elsewhere. Verify ambiguous outcomes before retrying.

check: Revoke delegated access, personal tokens and physical/authentication access through responsible owners
expected_evidence: Per-permission or asset result; actual scope, time and remaining exposure
notes: Do not assume cloud suspension removes local device access, a badge, a personal token or a third-party session.

check: Execute the approved preservation or transfer and capture actual job outcomes
approval_required: Approved method, source, destination and disclosure scope
expected_evidence: Population, actual job results, destination, errors and protected evidence
proposed_target: Before dependent deletion, wipe or license change
notes: Keep the source controlled; a submitted job or summary success without population evidence is insufficient.

check: Verify retrieval, permissions and preservation coverage with the approved recipient
approval_required: Approved safe retrieval and recipient scope
expected_evidence: Representative retrieval results; population reconciliation, missing items and destination permissions
notes: Sampled retrieval is bounded evidence; reconcile the expected population and investigate missing records.

check: Transfer approved business ownership, calendars, queues and provider contacts; test the receiving task
owner_role: Proposed Service owners and receiving operators
approval_required: Scoped business ownership/delegation and disclosure approval
expected_evidence: Supported reassignment plus actual receiving-workflow result or contingency
proposed_target: Before business dependency fails; retain owned gaps
notes: Do not log in as the former person; follow each service method and preserve access cutoff regardless of transfer progress.

check: Replace or revoke exposed shared secrets and recovery/custody authority using the dependency plan
owner_role: Proposed Privileged operators and service owners
approval_required: Credential/recovery change authority and continuity safeguards
expected_evidence: Affected consumers, scoped changes, replacement verification and residual gaps
notes: Conditional; do not blindly rotate unrelated secrets. Use approved contingency where a dependent service cannot change safely.

check: Reconcile assigned assets, actual receipt, identifiers and custody uncertainty
expected_evidence: Asset-by-asset received, in-transit, missing or held state and custody evidence
notes: Shipping status alone is not receipt; a queued wipe is neither asset recovery nor verified cleanup.

check: Authorize and verify device wipe, reassignment or disposal only after local-data and hold checks
owner_role: Proposed Device operator and asset owner
approval_required: Explicit destructive-action approval and preservation prerequisites
expected_evidence: Local-data/hold decision; authorized method; actual execution and verification or pending result
proposed_target: Only when action-specific prerequisites are satisfied
notes: Do not assume authority to wipe a whole personal device. A missing asset may have authorized remote cleanup; keep custody uncertainty visible.

check: Decide account deletion, mailbox state, license and subscription disposition separately
owner_role: Proposed Service, records and purchasing owners
approval_required: Action-specific records, technical and financial approval
expected_evidence: Approved disposition for each object; feature/hold/anchor dependencies; actual result or retained purpose/owner
proposed_target: After all applicable preservation and technical checks
notes: This is not an automatic delete step. Retain required account anchors and licensed features; verify downstream consequences first.

check: Independently assess known access population and unresolved session/offline exposure
approval_required: Approved administrative evidence and safe verification scope
expected_evidence: Per-target observations and times; coverage limits; failed, pending and unverified scope
proposed_target: At cutoff and after retries/material changes
notes: Review even when execution fails; do not use the former person password or impersonate them. Reference OFF-05 through OFF-08 and OFF-12.

check: Review failures, cancellation, late extension and temporary exceptions without hiding exposure
owner_role: Proposed IT coordinator and authorized decision-maker
approval_required: Explicit change or risk decision within scope
expected_evidence: Current exception/change reference; safeguard, owner, explicit expiry, earlier review triggers and retest
proposed_target: On change or failure and at review trigger
notes: Not applicable requires a reason. Cancellation does not automatically restore prior access; late extension does not excuse missed expiry.

check: Reconcile access, records/ownership, assets and account/license disposition as separate summaries
expected_evidence: Reviewer results; owner acknowledgments; linked remaining work, decisions and review times
proposed_target: When claimed scope is supported or explicitly limited
verifier_role: Proposed Technical reviewer and receiving owners
notes: Unresolved work means incomplete with owned exceptions. Link any separately managed case; handover receipt does not establish readiness.
